text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Let's see now, how about we take a stroll
around the castle town at dusk~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Trainer! Look over there,
are they not selling tortoiseshell crafts?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...You know, you're welcome to buy it for me!
Come on, come ooon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the shopping street
with No Reason poking and prodding me—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
You there, the Umamusume with the headband,
wanna try your luck?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, a raffle, is it?
Now what should I do...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: What?! Without a moment's hesitation?!
choice_data_list: I'm not buying anything, but I'll give you a prize.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph, you got me there!
You managed to slip away cleanly."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Very well, then.
Allow me to draw that lottery ticket for you, Master!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hand the raffle ticket to the man running the stall.
I only have one.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, a battle is fought but once.
There are no second chances in a realm-dividing clash.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer.
Let us turn the wheel—and spin for glory!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we grabbed the handle of the lottery wheel
and gave it a vigorous spin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: O-Ohhh, splendid~!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: The enemy commander is slain!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A grand victory in the Winter Lottery Campaign!
No Reason brilliantly snatched the grand prize.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the hot springs! The hot springs!
When our unification of the realm is finally achieved—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Now, let us head to the secret hot spring!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Long ago, the warlords of the Sengoku period—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It is said they kept a secret hot spring hidden away
to heal their wounds of war.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In order to prevail through a long, grueling battle,
one needs a secret haven like this!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Let us also soak leisurely in a secluded hot spring to soothe our wounds.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: And to quench a parched throat after a hot bath...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Cola, it's gotta be cola!
choice_data_list: Cola!? But we're going for a Japanese style!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Indeed! First, you pull the tab with a *pssshh*—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Down in one big gulp!
This is a classic overthrowing of plain milk!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-ha-ha!
Behold and witness my secret grand strategy!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, on the night of victory, we shall drink our fill
until dawn!! ...Of cola, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether it was poetic or not remained unclear,
but No Reason's motivation
erupted like carbonated soda.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, well done!
You bagged quite a big one!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this towering carrot...
It is just like a lone cedar standing upon a hill.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, in my younger days,
I too often aimed for the top of that hill.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Aye, right to the north of my homeland,
there was a great big hill.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"To see who could reach the top of a peak no one had ever climbed,
and do it the fastest—
that was how we Umamusume used to compete."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Well, in the end—

text_block_list.name: Young No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Woohoo!
First strike goes to me!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "...I rejoiced at the thought, but the truth was, I wasn't the first. Sitting proudly upon the mountain peak was a magnificent Western orchid."

text_block_list.name: Young No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my~, you're first?
Then I shall take second, I suppose."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It is said that after that,
climbers successfully reached the summit one after another.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "Even so, this carrot hamburg steak is rightfully suited for me, your seasoned senior!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well then Trainer,
let's head home and dig in.
Time to fill our bellies!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we enjoyed the delicious food while
listening to various stories about the northern hill.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Oho, a bumper crop, a bumper crop! What a magnificent sight to behold with so much of it~.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Eating it normally is fine and all,
but Trainer, before that...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Why not use this carrot to contend for supremacy with me?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now, follow me!
You'll understand once you're there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the place we arrived at was...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now, treat this field as a battlefield,
deploy the carrots, and take your formations!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I shall take the Western Army, and you the Eastern Army. Let us duel for supremacy over the land~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I know your skill in race tactics all too well, but let me see your flair as a military strategist!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Arranging the carrots as instructed,
the battle formation is finally complete—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ââ!! This is...!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Quite a flawless stance, isn't it?
A crane wing... no, a dual-threat formation
poised to charge from the flanks as well.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What?! You placed it there without knowing?
Well, that makes it all the more fascinating!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now, to battle!
The defeated troops shall serve as tonight's dinner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, after enjoying the Sengoku board game, they devoured the carrots that evening.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nwoh... A single... carrot!?
How the mighty have fallen.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "To think my reward would be such a puny dagger of a carrot..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this—
This is the end of the line!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, do not stop me!
If I must live with such shame, I'd rather—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason held that carrot high toward the heavens,
and then—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Deryah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――Chomp! Munch, munch...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—It was eaten.
In just a single bite."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I thought it was just a simple skewer,
but it is quite delicious, isn't it?
Splendid, splendid indeed!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
That was a magnificent end.
Now, let us be off, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason polished off the carrots in an instant
and briskly walked away.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Tissues...
Tissues... you say...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed.
A poem has come to me...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Entrusted upon
the eight-spoked wheel of fate,
my destined life spins."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ""Scattering like scrap paper, stamping through the earth.""

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Do you know what this means?
choice_data_list: No... what do you mean by "trample the earth"?
No... What do you mean by "trampling the earth"?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, stamping through the earth means, in essence—
something like this!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Vexing, vexing, how utterly vexing!
Gah, what am I to do about this!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So frustrated by drawing a dud,
No Reason kept stomping her feet
in sheer annoyance...
